messages:
Olivia: Hey sec team — need a short-lived SSH agent elevation to pair into a customer-reported node for a KV rotation rollback. Won't touch data exports, just need `ssh -A` to pick up my key for a 20m session. Can we get a JIT window? Context: rolling back the postgres KMS unwrap because one node failed to rotate and is stuck in read-only.
Ben: Can you add a one-line justification and the exact target host(s)? We need auditability and a ticket reference. Also prefer session-manager where possible.
Olivia: Ticket INC-4982. Targets: `prod-kv-03.internal.redwood` (port 3022), maybe `prod-kv-04` if replication quirks show up. Justification: rollback to previous KMS config to restore writes; will run a read-only sanity first, then revert if safe.
Ben: OK pls include the exact commands you will run in the approval. Tag `security-review` on the ticket. We'll require ephemeral sudo, MFA, and session recording.
Olivia: Commands I expect to run: ```ssh -A ops@prod-kv-03 -p 3022 # forward agent
sudo /opt/redwood/bin/kv-rotate --rollback --reason "INC-4982"
/opt/redwood/bin/kv-check --sanity``` Will not copy any DB dumps out.
sec-bot: Policy check: JIT elevations allowed for "maintenance/rollback" with max 30m. Requires 2 approvers from team `eng-security` or `eng-ops`. Audit logging enabled by default. Link: https://internal.redwood/sec/jit
Kai: I can +1 for ops side, happy to observe. Can we limit to 15m first and extend if needed? :thumbsup:
Andre: I can approve from security if you add the `--dry-run` check first and share session URL for review. Will you be sharing a live terminal in a call?
Olivia: Yes will start with `--dry-run` then `--rollback` only if checks pass. Planning to share terminal via Zoom and paste session link into INC-4982. Start window requested in 20m for 15m.
Ben: Approved conditional on: (1) add command with `--dry-run` step in ticket, (2) start within next 45m, (3) post session URL and duration in ticket, (4) no data export. Approving for 15 minutes from 2024-05-11T15:30Z (audit token `APPROVAL-1745328901-BEN`). :lock:
sec-bot: JIT grant created: grant_id=jit-20240511-1745328901, expiry=900s. Audit link: https://internal.redwood/audit/jit-20240511-1745328901
Olivia: Got it — starting at 15:30Z, will post session link and logs to INC-4982. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
Kai: I'll hop in to watch.
Andre: Observing as well. Good luck.
Olivia: Done — session URL posted to INC-4982 and paste below for records: https://replay.redwood/session/4f3c2b. Logs will be attached to the ticket within 1h. Thanks for the quick turnaround.
